banner.start: Set up your first mission — two steps, and you can stop at any point.
banner.resume: You were setting up your first mission. Pick up at step {step} of 2?

mission.title: What do you want to get better at, and why?
mission.why: The why is not decoration. Everything the app does later reads it — what to suggest, what to review, what to drop when you are short of time.

focus.title: Do 15 minutes on it now.
focus.why: The habit is the product. Everything above is setup; this is the thing itself.
focus.intention: What does done look like for these 15 minutes?

done.title: That's the loop.
done.body: You have a mission and a session running. Nothing here was demo data — it is all yours to edit or delete.
